mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARATHON_CONTEST_TYPE A, MARATHON_APPLICANT B, MARATHON_CONTEST C WHERE A.homepage_id = B.homepage_id AND B.homepage_id = C.homepage_id AND A.contest_idx = B.contest_idx AND B.contest_idx = C.contest_idx AND A.contest_type_idx = B.contest_type_idx AND B.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND B.member_id = #{member_id}

${pagingTop} SELECT B.homepage_id, B.contest_idx, B.contest_type_idx, B.applicant_idx, B.member_id, B.member_name, B.age_type, B.school_name, B.school_class, B.zipcode, B.email, B.gender, B.address_dong, B.address_one, B.address_two, B.telephone, B.cellphone, B.birthday, B.contest_type, A.page_count, B.finish_memorial, B.determination_talk, B.process_status, B.add_date, B.modify_date, B.modify_id, C.contest_name, B.finish_date, ( SELECT NVL(SUM(read_page_count), 0) FROM MARATHON_RECORD WHERE homepage_id = B.homepage_id AND contest_idx = B.contest_idx AND contest_type_idx = B.contest_type_idx AND applicant_idx = B.applicant_idx AND member_id = B.member_id ) AS read_page_count_total FROM MARATHON_CONTEST_TYPE A, MARATHON_APPLICANT B, MARATHON_CONTEST C WHERE A.homepage_id = B.homepage_id AND B.homepage_id = C.homepage_id AND A.contest_idx = B.contest_idx AND B.contest_idx = C.contest_idx AND A.contest_type_idx = B.contest_type_idx AND B.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND B.member_id = #{member_id} ORDER BY B.add_date DESC, B.contest_type_idx, B.applicant_idx ${pagingBottom}

SELECT B.homepage_id, B.contest_idx, B.contest_type_idx, B.applicant_idx, B.member_id, B.member_name, B.age_type, B.school_name, B.school_class, B.zipcode, B.email, B.gender, B.address_dong, B.address_one, B.address_two, B.telephone, B.cellphone, B.birthday, B.contest_type, A.page_count, B.finish_memorial, B.determination_talk, B.process_status, B.add_date, B.modify_date, B.modify_id, C.contest_name, B.read_page_count_total, B.finish_date FROM MARATHON_CONTEST_TYPE A, MARATHON_APPLICANT B, MARATHON_CONTEST C WHERE A.homepage_id = B.homepage_id AND B.homepage_id = C.homepage_id AND A.contest_idx = B.contest_idx AND B.contest_idx = C.contest_idx AND A.contest_type = B.contest_type AND B.contest_idx = #{contest_idx} AND B.contest_type_idx = #{contest_type_idx} AND B.applicant_idx = #{applicant_idx} AND B.homepage_id = #{homepage_id}

SELECT B.homepage_id, B.contest_idx, B.contest_type_idx, B.applicant_idx, B.member_id, B.member_name, B.age_type, B.school_name, B.school_class, B.zipcode, B.email, B.gender, B.address_dong, B.address_one, B.address_two, B.telephone, B.cellphone, B.birthday, B.contest_type, A.page_count, B.finish_memorial, B.determination_talk, B.process_status, B.add_date, B.modify_date, B.modify_id, C.contest_name, B.read_page_count_total, B.finish_date FROM MARATHON_CONTEST_TYPE A, MARATHON_APPLICANT B, MARATHON_CONTEST C WHERE A.homepage_id = B.homepage_id AND B.homepage_id = C.homepage_id AND A.contest_idx = B.contest_idx AND B.contest_idx = C.contest_idx AND A.contest_type = B.contest_type AND B.contest_idx = #{contest_idx} AND B.member_id = #{member_id} AND B.homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT contest_idx, contest_name FROM MARATHON_CONTEST WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id}
SELECT contest_type_idx, contest_type, application_subject FROM MARATHON_CONTEST_TYPE WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND contest_idx = #{contest_idx}
